notes.title: Update Notes for February 5
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where talents could not be upgraded

notes.title: 2024.11.11 Update Announcement
notes.notes: 1. At the end of the optimization round, the spiritual power will be retained.

notes.title: 2024.11.9 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the settlement interface, the return button will not appear when the character reaches the maximum level
2. Fixed the problem that when the deck has less than 5 cards, only 1-2 cards are drawn at the beginning
3. Optimized monster generation, the boss spawn position is in the last two rows

notes.title: 2024.11.8 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the problem that [Soul-Fixing Elixir] has a chance of no effect
2. Fixed the problem that when the discard deck and the current deck are both 0, an empty card will be generated if the card drawn is used
3. Fixed the problem that when removing a card, the game will freeze if there are less than 5 cards left
4. Fixed the problem that the card level will not be retained when the card is upgraded
5. Fixed the problem that the shield value will suddenly disappear when being hit
6. Fixed the problem that the Onmyoji experience value and experience bar are not displayed normally when selecting a character

notes.title: 2024.11.7 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the problem that monsters would not spawn
2. Fixed the problem that cards would appear when the discard pile was 0
3. Fixed the problem that the bottom frame of the button would not disappear after the elixir was used
4. Fixed the problem that the magic weapon would appear repeatedly
5. Fixed the problem that the paralysis effect would not disappear after the monster died
6. Fixed the problem that the card reward was wrong when clearing the small boss and fighting the boss
7. Fixed the problem that the card could not be used on [Skeleton Axe Soldier]
8. Fixed the problem that the animation of [Shikigami Wolf Demon] would not switch when selecting a character
9. Fixed the problem that the experience bar would get stuck and there was no return button when the experience was settled
10. Optimize the talent reset function

notes.title: 2024.11.6 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Adjust the effects of the Talisman Master's [Lightning] and [Thunder Surge] cards
2. Adjust the effects of some Onmyoji cards
3. Adjust the shield rules, and adjust the attenuation to zero in the next round
4. Add status buff icon display, above the unit, move the mouse to the icon to view details
5. Fix the problem that the card cannot be upgraded

notes.title: 2024.11.4 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Fixed Onmyoji [Curse Injury] card
2. After clicking the elixir, the text color will change when the mouse moves to the use/sell/close button
3. Fixed the problem of overlapping units after moving, and increased the movement speed
4. Fixed the problem that other level types do not appear in the level selection

notes.title: 2024.11.2 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Optimize Onmyoji's Fatal Blow and Wind Spirit Power skills, now they will have an effect on all friendly units
2. Adjust Onmyoji's [Spiritual] card effect, shield value increased
3. Adjust Onmyoji's [Wind Blade Combo] card effect
4. Shikigami Yudie's spiritual energy recovery per second increased to 15
5. Shikigami Yuki Onna's [Ice Ground Spike] freezing probability increased, initial damage increased
6. Shikigami Shuten Doji's initial health increased
7. Repair the freezing special effect will not be destroyed when the monster dies
8. Adjust Onmyoji's initial card
9. Optimize the display of unactivated and activated talent icons

notes.title: Update content on 2024.10.29
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug of the Berserker card - Blood Connection
2. Reworked most Berserker cards
3. Reworked the Berserker Rage Slash effect, and you can get Rage value by using attack cards
4. Adjusted the Spirit Fire and Spirit Thunder of the Talisman Master:
When using a card with one attribute, the value of another attribute is reduced by 1 point. Adjusted to: convert the accumulated value to the attribute of the card currently in use
For example: if there are 3 points of Spirit Fire, after using a Thunder card, the 3 points of Spirit Fire will be converted into 3 points of Spirit Thunder and increase by 1 point Spirit Thunder
5. Optimize the rules for using spirit pills, and you can use them even before the battle begins
6. Adjust the price of store items to make them more affordable
7. Add a card removal function that can be used in the store
8. You will have 50 soul stones as the starting capital at the beginning of the game
9. Rework the level selection and generation rules. Targeted card rewards will appear in the levels of ordinary monsters and elite monsters. Move the mouse to the icon to view relevant information.
10. Adjust skills and card effects
11. Adjust the shield effect, reducing it by 10% per second

notes.title: 2024.10.13 update content
notes.notes:
1. Redesign character actions
2. Adjust the display of some special effects
3. Character strengthening and upgrading skills are gathered together and can be upgraded at the same time
4. Fixed the issue where the card icon did not disappear when all rewards were skipped.
5. Enlargement of character and monster models
6. Added a new difficulty selection interface to make the introduction of difficulty more intuitive.
